title: Mo Gilligan – The Mo You Know
content: Mo Gilligan is one of the UK’s most successful comedians and television personalities, known from The Lateish Show with Mo Gilligan and as a judge on The Masked Singer. He has won three BAFTA awards, toured the world with sold-out shows, and released the book That Moment When…. In 2025, he completed the acclaimed In the Moment World Tour, featuring sold-out dates across the USA, Australia, New Zealand and London’s O2 Arena.
excerpt: The triple BAFTA-winning comedian Mo Gilligan embarks on his biggest world tour to date in 2026 – The Mo You Know.

featuredmedia.alt_text: Press photo: Mo Gilligan, black background, orange text 'Mo Gilligan.

title: Labero – A Magic Night 2026
content: Lorensbergsteatern welcomes you to A Magic Night. Feel the energy vibrate as one of the world’s most skilled illusionists performs his favorite acts and famous close-ups. Prepare yourself for an evening where the impossible becomes possible. Step into a mysterious journey through Joe Labero’s magical world.
excerpt: Labero – one of the most legendary magicians of our time – is returning to Scandinavia.

title: Deep Purple
content:
Few bands have left as strong a mark on rock history as Deep Purple. Since the late sixties, their music has shaped hard rock, and their live performances have become a benchmark for both musicians and fans. With “Smoke on the Water,” more than 100 million albums sold, and a career spanning several decades, their significance is undeniable.

When Deep Purple return to Scandinavium next autumn, they continue a story that stretches back more than fifty years. Gothenburg has welcomed the band many times over the decades, and the arena has become a natural home for their powerful concerts. Their classics and unmistakable energy continue to draw both long-time followers and new listeners.

This is an opportunity to experience a band that still stands firmly at the top. Joining them as support is Jayler.
excerpt: On October 29, 2026, Deep Purple return to Gothenburg for an evening at Scandinavium. More than fifty years after their first performance at the arena, the rock icons once again take the stage, this time with Jayler as support.

featuredmedia.alt_text: Deep Purple standing next to each other in dark clothes.

title: Lucia celebration in Sankt Pauli kyrka
content:
The choir Sankt Pauli kyrkokör and the youth choir perform under the direction of Mikael Holmlund and Inese P Johansson.

Free admission – limited seating.
Doors open at 17:15.
Location: Sankt Pauli kyrka, Sankt Pauli Kyrkoplan 1, Gothenburg.
excerpt: An atmospheric Lucia celebration with the parish church choir and youth choir.

featuredmedia.alt_text: A Lucia crown with candles casts an atmospheric glow in a church interior.

location.address: Sankt Pauli kyrka, Sankt Pauli Kyrkoplan, Göteborg, Sverige
location.name: Sankt Pauli kyrka, Göteborg

title: Wicked
content:
In October 2026, the largest-ever production of Wicked returns – the smash-hit musical that has taken the world by storm. The Göteborg Opera’s acclaimed staging swept the audience off their feet during its first run, playing to sold-out houses and seen by over 110,000 people.

The Wicked musical tells the tale of the two witches of Oz before Dorothy dropped in on them in the classic MGM musical The Wizard of Oz. Find out how Elphaba and Glinda met and became the Wicked Witch and the Good Witch respectively, and how they succeeded in defeating the tyrannical Wizard of Oz. This is a tale of social exclusion, courage and love, told with magic, fantasy and wonderful music. A number of songs from the show have been hits, including “Defying Gravity”.

Musical stars Feline Andersson and Anna Salonen return to their breakthrough roles as Elphaba, “the Wicked Witch of the West”, and Galinda, who transforms into Glinda the good.

Wicked is one of the world’s most popular musicals. The original Broadway production premiered in 2003 opened in London’s West End three years later. The Swedish premiere at the Göteborg Opera in 2023, directed by Samuel Harjanne, was (and is) the largest ever production of the musical, with an expanded orchestra, large ensemble and breathtaking scenery.
excerpt: Musical in two acts. Music and lyrics by Stephen Schwartz. Book by Winnie Holzman. Based on the novel by Gregory Maguire. Direction Samuel Harjanne. Swedish translation by Calle Norlén.

featuredmedia.alt_text: A witch dressed in green with a pointed hat and staff, set against a large ornate clock in green hues

category_heading: Musical of the witches of Oz

title: Body. Ideal, Gaze, Freedom
content:
In the exhibition Body. Ideal, Gaze, Freedom, works and artists from different eras come together to explore and challenge historical and contemporary ideals, the role of the model, and the body’s own potential for expression and creativity.

The rich presentation includes painting, sculpture, drawing, and prints, as well as photography and video works. The majority of the more than 100 artworks are part of the museum’s collection, with artists including Hanna Pauli, Francis Bacon, and Charlotte Gyllenhammar.

The exhibition also features works by Nick Cave, Ana Mendieta, and Hannah Wilke, on loan from other institutions, along with contributions from participating contemporary artists such as Sally von Rosen and Ruby Okoro.
excerpt: This spring, a major exhibition opens at the Gothenburg Museum of Art, exploring one of the greatest and most timeless themes in art history – the body.

title: Amon Amarth
content:
Amon Amarth return to Sweden next autumn with their extensive The Allfather Awakens Tour, and Gothenburg is one of the stops. For the first time, the band take over Scandinavium, an arena that gives full space to their large scale productions, charged with fire, mythology and arena metal of the heaviest kind.

Gothenburg, a central force in Swedish metal for decades, will get a night where three of the country’s most influential acts gather under the same roof. Joining Amon Amarth are the acclaimed special guests Orbit Culture and Soilwork, two bands that bring their own expression and raise the level even further.
excerpt: On October 23 2026, Amon Amarth come to Gothenburg for their first ever show at Scandinavium.

featuredmedia.alt_text: Animated viking.

title: Europe
content:
When The Final Countdown was released in 1986, the album became a global sensation. The title track topped the charts in 25 countries, the album sold multi-platinum, and stayed on the American Billboard chart for over 60 weeks. In the digital era, its success continues: in 2022, Europe became the first Swedish band to reach one billion views on YouTube for a single song – and today the video is approaching 1.4 billion views.

The upcoming The Final Countdown 40th Anniversary Tour will visit 12 countries and offer a unique concert experience. Europe will perform a career-spanning set that concludes with them playing the entire The Final Countdown album in full, only for the second time in the band’s history.
excerpt: Next year marks forty years since The Final Countdown took over the world, and Europe are celebrating it with a major international tour that will make two stops in Sweden. On October 23, the band will perform at Filmstudion in Gothenburg.

featuredmedia.alt_text: The members of the band Europe.

title: Benjamin Ingrosso
content:
With What Happens Next? Benjamin Ingrosso continues to grow as a live artist, and the Gothenburg shows offer audiences a chance to experience him in a production created with the arena setting in mind. He has long been a prominent voice in Swedish pop, and his music continues to find listeners both at home and beyond Sweden’s borders.

The tour is his first in Sweden since the Better Days Tour in 2024, which drew over 175,000 attendees in Sweden alone. During the same period he received wide recognition, including becoming the most awarded artist at both P3 Guld and the 2025 Grammis Awards.

The evenings at Scandinavium allows him to build on that momentum, with his melodies, lyrics and stage presence supported by a full-scale arena production.

Age limit: 13 years.
excerpt: On October 24 and 25, Benjamin Ingrosso returns to Gothenburg with the arena tour What Happens Next? for two concerts at Scandinavium. Two evenings where one of Sweden’s most beloved live artists meets one of the city’s most iconic venues.

title: Seaweed & Tapas
content:
Have you heard that seaweed is edible? Seaweed diver and culinary creator Karolina Martinson takes you on an exciting food journey into the pantry of the blue nutrients and prepares Seaweed and Tapas in a unique way. Fun, inspiring, and very delicious. After enjoying tapas and sparkling seaweed drink on the Sauna Raft, Kajkanten light the wood-fired sauna. For those who wish, the evening ends with a refreshing cold dip.

Dates for Seaweed & Tapas

  • February 28
  • March 21
  • October 10
  • November 7

Or choose your own date for smaller groups – by request.

Seaweed, tapas and a warming sauna

  • Inspirational talk and live cooking with Karolina on the Sauna Raft, Saturdays at 18:00
  • Small dishes served: Tapas and Seaweed Bubbles (non-alcoholic drink)
  • Access to the wood-fired sauna, hot tub and cold plunge starting around 19.30
excerpt: Food creator Karolina Martinson invites you on an exciting culinary journey into the pantry of the blue food sector.

featuredmedia.alt_text: Karolina Martinson wearing a diving suit, she is smiling and holding up seaweed in her hand.

title: Lorentz
content:
For over a decade, Lorentz has been one of Sweden’s most influential voices in modern pop and hip-hop, establishing himself as one of the country’s most innovative and trend-shaping artists.

With a rich musical legacy, celebrated albums, and a sound that continually pushes the boundaries of the Swedish music scene, Lorentz delivers a live experience defined by precision, emotion, and artistic expression.
excerpt: Currently riding the momentum of his critically acclaimed album Asfalten, with new music coming in 2026!

title: Smokie
content: The iconic band behind hits like “Living Next Door to Alice,” “Needles and Pins,” “Have You Ever Seen the Rain,” “Lay Back in the Arms of Someone,” and “For a Few Dollars More” will be performing at Partille Arena in November 2026.
excerpt: Smokie is coming to Partille Arena!

featuredmedia.alt_text: Smokie, black background, name in white text

title: waterbaby
content:
By exploring the intensity of falling in love and the emotional landscapes that shape her artistry, the upcoming shows become an immersive extension of the music’s raw honesty and rich arrangements.

waterbaby made her breakthrough in 2022 with the breakout hit “Stockholmsvy” (feat. Hannes), followed by the internationally acclaimed singles “Airforce Blue” and “911” the year after. Backed by the prestigious label Sub Pop, she has already earned recognition from tastemakers such as The New York Times, The Guardian, NME, Stereogum, The FADER, and BBC Radio 1.
excerpt: The Stockholm-born singer-songwriter waterbaby is taking her dark, nostalgic world on the road.

featuredmedia.alt_text: Press photo waterbaby

title: Sharks, Camera, Action!
content: The exhibition portrays some of the sharks that inhabit cold seas, species about which we know surprisingly little. Through spectacular films and images, you will encounter everything from a baby shark to the legendary Greenland shark, while also gaining a glimpse behind the camera. An exploration that both sparks curiosity and highlights the crucial role sharks play in the oceans’ biodiversity.
excerpt: Join nature filmmaker Christina Karliczek Skoglund on a journey beneath the surface – from the coast of Bohuslän to the depths of Greenland.

featuredmedia.alt_text: Uli Kunz films a shark underwater.

title: Paddan city canal tour with guide
content:
Step aboard the classic sightseeing boats in the middle of the city at Kungsportsplatsen and experience the old moat, canals from the 17th century and the history of Gothenburg’s construction and defense.

During the journey, you will pass attractions such as the Gothenburg Opera, Feskekörka, Läppstiftet, the old shipyard areas and green parks.

The guide on board will tell you about the city’s history and present, attractions along the way interspersed with anecdotes and stories that have shaped the city. The Paddan tour is one of the most well-known ways to experience Gothenburg.
excerpt: See the beauty of Gothenburg from the water on the classic Paddan boat tour, passing under 20 bridges.

featuredmedia.alt_text: Boat in the canal.

title: Hop On–Hop Off bus in Gothenburg
content:
The buses are double-decker without a roof. This tour passes most of Gothenburg’s interesting sights, both historical and contemporary.

You can get on and off as many times as you like during a 24-hour period from the various stops along the journey. The entire trip takes approximately 50 minutes.

Audio guide available in:

Swedish, English, German, Spanish, French and Italian.

In case of bad weather, there is a protective roof that can be quickly mounted on the buses.

Please note! Dates and times are subject to change. For the exact departures from Stora Teatern – click on the ticket button on the right.
excerpt: Hop on a sightseeing tour around Gothenburg.

featuredmedia.alt_text: Sightseeing bus on a bridge.

title: Archipelago tour with guide
content:
This popular 2.5-hour live-guided tour takes you through Gothenburg’s bustling harbor and onward to the islands of the southern archipelago. The flagships M/S S:t Erik or M/S Carl Michael Bellman,  take you from Lilla Bommen through the port of Gothenburg, past the historic Nya Älvsborg Fortress and onward to the islands of the southern archipelago.

During the journey, the guide shares stories and insights about the sights along the route, while you enjoy magnificent views from the deck or the saloon. Light snacks and beverages are available for purchase on board.

Enhance your experience by pre-booking lunch and choose between the daily meat, fish, or vegetarian option. On the 3:00 PM departure of the Little Archipelago Tour, you can also choose a Swedish fika with pastries, coffee and tea, or a classic shrimp sandwich. A reserved seat in the dining saloon is included. Please note that bringing your own food or drinks on board is not permitted.
excerpt: Experience Gothenburg’s beautiful archipelago on a guided sightseeing boat tour.

featuredmedia.alt_text: Old boat in the harbour

title: Seafood Cruise with entertainment
content:
During the evening fresh prawns, crayfish, mussels, herring, salmon, and pickled herring are served, along with classic sides. Lobster and oysters can be pre-ordered.

The cruise features singing, dancing and well-known songs, with the performing artists also serving throughout the evening.

As the sun sets, the boat glides through Gothenburg’s southern archipelago, with cliffs, islands and open sea framing the experience.
excerpt: Join a evening cruise with Skärgårdslinjen.

featuredmedia.alt_text: Performers in sailor outfits entertain passengers on the deck of a Skärgårdslinjen cruise boat during an evening show, while guests watch and applaud.

title: EURO MTB 2027
content:
Once again, Sweden has the opportunity to showcase itself as host of a major international MTB championship. CK Master is proud and delighted to organise the European Mountain Bike Championships and to welcome the European cycling community to a true festival atmosphere in Gothenburg.

“Hosting a championship of this calibre is the result of many years of hard work. We hope the event will not only deliver world-class racing, but also inspire more people – especially young riders – to discover the joy of cycling. Together with the UEC, the Swedish Cycling Federation, Gothenburg & Co, Visit West Sweden and our partners, we look forward to creating an unforgettable competition week,” – CK Master

The European Mountain Bike Championships have long held an important place on the international competition calendar, and the 2027 edition will be particularly significant as it takes place the year before the Olympic Games in Los Angeles.

For Swedish MTB riders, the championships also represent a unique opportunity to compete in an international championship on home soil.

The detailed competition schedule for each day has not yet been finalised. Follow the website and social media channels for ongoing updates.

Spectator information

The course is designed to be close to the action for spectators without compromising elevation gain or technical difficulty. Anyone wishing to experience the races on site is warmly welcome to Skatås.

Location: Gothenburg MTB Race, Skatås, Brudaremossen 20, Gothenburg.
More information about the MTB European Championships 2027: euromtb.com.
excerpt: Experience the world’s elite as they compete for medals at the 2027 European Mountain Bike Championships! The championships include Olympic-format cross-country (XCO), short track (XCC) and the high-intensity mixed team relay between nations (XCR). The event also serves as a qualifying competition for the 2028 Olympic Games.

featuredmedia.alt_text: A large group of cyclists in colourful racing kits start a mountain bike race on a grassy course, with an inflatable start arch and green trees in the background.

title: Hanna Vihriälä
content:
In the exhibition, Hanna Vihriälä transforms everyday materials into poetic, floating formations. With an expression that oscillates between the playful and the meticulously constructed, she explores how beauty, fragility, and the passage of time can take physical form. The exhibition invites visitors into a world where what appears light carries a deeper weight.

On display are a selection of sculptures from recent years, as well as two entirely new works being shown to the public for the very first time.
excerpt: The Gothenburg Museum of Art presents Finnish artist Hanna Vihriälä’s first solo exhibition in Sweden.

title: Realm of Shadows
content:
Spies fascinate us. For thousands of years, people have gathered secret information, protected their own secrets and moved in the shadows between truth and deception.

In the 2026 season, Maritiman opens the doors to a brand-new exhibition about espionage. Here, real-world intelligence work, historical spies and authentic missions meet the most iconic spy figures from film, games and popular culture.

The exhibition offers compelling stories, unexpected perspectives and hands-on challenges where children can test their own spy skills. A world filled with mystery, cunning and secrets – for the whole family.

Realm of Shadows – an exhibition about real-world spies and popular culture representations of espionage throughout history.

Opening 2 April 2026.
excerpt: The exhibition takes visitors into the hidden world of espionage – where real-world intelligence work meets the myths of film, games and popular culture.

featuredmedia.caption: Realm of Shadows – Espionage at the intersection of fact and fiction.
featuredmedia.alt_text: Illustration of a child with goggles in the foreground, in front of a submarine and a harbor environment in night lights. The image conveys a playful spy theme with maritime elements.

title: Candlelight The Best of Hans Zimmer
content: This innovative format offers a unique musical experience through a diverse selection of programmes, catering to all tastes. Performed by talented local musicians in iconic venues illuminated by thousands of candles, Candlelight creates an immersive and intimate atmosphere.
excerpt: Experience the very best of Hans Zimmer by candlelight at Draken Live.

featuredmedia.alt_text: Four musicians in a string quartet perform on stage, surrounded by hundreds of golden candles creating a warm and atmospheric setting. Two violinists, a violist and a cellist sit in a circle with music stands in front of them.

title: Pétanque World Championship 2027
content:
This will be the first time Sweden hosts the Pétanque World Championships in their current format, where the singles and doubles championships are decided in alternating years. The event also coincides with the 50th anniversary of the Swedish Boules Federation and is expected to become a major celebration for both players and spectators.

Ahead of the championships, Scandinavium will be transformed into a pétanque arena filled with gravel and international elite sport. Each nation will be represented by four players, two women and two men. World champions will be crowned in five disciplines: women’s singles, men’s singles, women’s doubles, men’s doubles, and mixed doubles. Up to 50 nations from around the world are expected to take part.

With its central location, Scandinavium provides excellent conditions for both intense competition and a vibrant event atmosphere around the playing area. The championships are aimed at dedicated pétanque fans as well as curious first time visitors, offering strategic gameplay, high precision, and strong emotions.
excerpt: The Pétanque World Championships will take place in Gothenburg on September 2–5 2027. With Scandinavium as the venue, the world’s best pétanque players will compete for the world championship titles.

title: Brunch cruise in the Southern Archipelago
content:
On board M/S Göteborg, a brunch buffet is served with pickled herring, salmon, meatballs, cheeses, salads, and dessert. The brunch is prepared on board, and during the cruise you can sit in the ship’s dining areas and enjoy views of the archipelago.

For groups who want a more private setting, it is possible to book a private lounge on the upper deck. The lounge offers views of the archipelago and a private seating area. The lounge must be booked in advance via Strömma.
excerpt: A three-hour cruise through the Gothenburg archipelago.

featuredmedia.alt_text: Steamboat cruising in the Gothenburg archipelago with rocky islands in the background.

title: Archipelago cruise with a troubadour
content:
Experience an evening aboard M/S Göteborg. During the cruise through the Gothenburg archipelago, a dinner and dessert buffet is served, and the evening’s troubadour performs live music. The ship passes islands such as Brännö, Styrsö, and Asperö.

The cruise departs from Lilla Bommen harbor and continues into the archipelago. For groups who want a more private setting, it is possible to book a private lounge.
excerpt: Dinner buffet and music aboard M/S Göteborg.

featuredmedia.alt_text: Boat deck with railing and sea view of the Gothenburg archipelago

title: Archipelago tour with lunch
content:
The boat departs from Lilla Bommen for a 2.5-hour sightseeing tour in the Gothenburg archipelago. On board M/S Carl Michael Bellman or M/S S:t Erik, today’s lunch is served while the guide shares stories about the harbour, historic fortresses, and islands.

The ticket includes a seat in the dining area, today’s lunch, and a live-guided tour in Swedish and English. Choose between meat, fish, or a vegetarian option. Snacks, coffee, and drinks are available for purchase on board.
excerpt: Join a guided cruise through Gothenburg Harbour and the southern archipelago.

featuredmedia.alt_text: Older cruise boat at a distance in the water at dusk, with an archipelago island in the background.

title: Shrimp and Salmon Archipelago Cruise
content:
The evening begins with a welcome glass of sparkling wine, followed by a buffet with prawns, salmon, pickled herring, and mussels. During dinner, the evening’s troubadour provides live music.

The cruise passes through Gothenburg’s southern archipelago, including islands such as Styrsö, Donsö, and Brännö. Views are available from both the dining area and the deck. Lobster or langoustines can be pre-ordered as an extra. Dessert is available for purchase after the cruise.
excerpt: Join a 3-hour cruise aboard the classic M/S S:t Erik.

featuredmedia.alt_text: Older cruise boat on the water with a dusk sky and an archipelago island in the background.

title: Shrimp cruise in the archipelago
content:
Experience an evening aboard the classic archipelago ship M/S Göteborg while cruising through Gothenburg’s archipelago.

The cruise departs from Lilla Bommen Harbor. You will be served generous bowls of fresh sustainably sourced shrimp with classic accompaniments such as aioli, mayonnaise, bread, and butter. Freshly boiled langoustines can be pre-ordered as an extra. Dessert and coffee are available for purchase after the cruise.
excerpt: Eat as much as you like and enjoy the views onboard M/S Göteborg.

featuredmedia.alt_text: Wooden boat deck and windows, with archipelago, water, and sunset in the background.

title: Ocean bus Gothenburg
content:
Experience the highlights of Gothenburg in 60 minutes. Fasten your seatbelt and relax.

Book tickets on the website or purchase on site at Stora Teatern, subject to availability.

Minimum age: 3 years.

The bus has both a roof and windows. The windows can be opened in good weather for the best experience.

Live guide:

English and Swedish (70/30)
excerpt: Take the Shark Bus for a live-guided sightseeing tour on both land and water.

featuredmedia.alt_text: A bus traveling in the water near a harbor area with buildings and a bridge in the background.

title: Viva Sounds 2026
content:
Viva Sounds – International club festival

Viva Sounds is an international club festival, a music conference, and a musical meeting place, held for the ninth time. The live programme will present over 100 shows and around 100 acts giving it their all on 17 venues within walking distance, with capacities ranging from 50 to 1,000 people. Viva Sounds is about meeting and celebrating live music – smiles, concerts, and sticky floors.

Venues and line-up

Gothenburg’s indie festival lights up the city’s iconic venues with pulsing live music. From Pustervik to Oceanen and Hängmattan, it’s where music, culture, and community vibe together for a few magical days.

The festival venues are *The Abyss, *2Lång, *Skivhandeln, *Holy Moly, *Eli’s Corner, *Fyrens ölkafé, Gathenhielmska huset, Musikens Hus and Hängmattan, Kulturlagret, Oceanen, Pustervik, Skeppet Gbg and Utopia. * = Free admission.

Artists are announced continuously at vivasounds.se/line-up.

The conference

The conference is held at four venues along Andra Långgatan and takes place in bars and restaurants to create an open environment for conversations and meetings. Last year, more than 250 delegates from over 20 countries took part. The conference is open to everyone, and anyone interested can purchase a ticket. More information will be published on the Viva Sounds website.

Viva Sounds 2026

Viva Sounds 2026 is the ninth edition of the festival, organised by Westside Music – a platform representing around 60 local indie labels in and around Gothenburg. The programme is built in three parts: one third from the local scene, one third through national collaborations, and one third from international connections. The selection is based on relationships rather than titles, creating a close and accessible context.
excerpt: Viva Sounds is a multi-venue festival in Gothenburg, taking place on November 26–28. The 2026 edition will feature more than 100 concerts by 90+ bands and artists from all over the world, across 17 different venues – all within walking distance of eachother.

featuredmedia.alt_text: Concert audience with two people wearing wizard hats and blue capes

title: Göteborg Film Festival 2027
content:
The 50th Edition – January 29–February 27 2026

Each year, the festival’s programme committee travels the world in search of the finest films to bring to Göteborg. Over eleven days in late January, the city comes alive with a celebration of cinema, presenting around 250 films from 80 countries in some 700 screenings. The festival also welcomes hundreds of film guests – directors, actors, cinematographers and producers – who meet audiences both in the theatres and in more informal settings. At the festival’s closing gala, the prestigious Dragon Awards are presented to the winners in the festival’s competition sections.

About Göteborg Film Festival

Göteborg Film Festival is the largest film festival in the Nordic region and was founded in 1979. Today it attracts around 270,000 visits, both in cinemas and online. The festival is not only about film but also offers talks, parties, concerts and a wide range of other activities.

Online

Since 2021, a curated selection of the festival’s films has also been premiered online for audiences throughout Sweden.

Industry days

The festival’s industry days, featuring events like TV Drama Vision and Nordic Film Market, serve as the premier marketplace for Nordic film and TV drama and are an essential meeting point for industry professionals worldwide.

Read more about Göteborg Film Festival in our guide on goteborg.com.
excerpt: Meet filmmakers, attend exclusive film premieres, mingle with fellow film lovers and enjoy an exciting evening programme across Gothenburg. Or join the festival online from anywhere in Sweden.

featuredmedia.alt_text: Audience in a large theater hall with several balconies.

title: VegoKraft – Vegan Fair & Meeting Place
content:
On Sunday, November 1, from 10:00–16:00, enjoy a day filled with inspiration, new knowledge and opportunities to meet others.

At the fair, you can:

  • meet a variety of exhibitors
  • browse and shop
  • listen to inspiring talks
  • network with other visitors
  • take part in prize draws and giveaways
  • meet friends and like-minded people
  • enjoy food, coffee and a relaxed day at the fair

The fair takes place indoors in Kviberg, Gothenburg, and is organised by Veganna.

Tickets for both visitors and exhibitors are available through Tickster. Talks require a separate ticket.

Book in advance to secure your place and bring along family, friends or colleagues.
excerpt: Discover an inspiring vegan fair featuring plant-based and vegan products, services and organisations.

title: Göteborgsslöjdarna’s Christmas Market
content:
Artisans will be demonstrating their techniques in ceramics, woodwork, felting, knitting, rag‑rug weaving, rope work, sheepskin craft, textiles, honey production and more. You can also buy delicious pickled vegetables as well as homemade jams and marmalades. A small needle‑felting workshop will be available.

Location: Roten. No admission fee.
excerpt: Göteborgslöjdarna (the Göteborg craftspeople) are hosting a small Christmas market at the Botanical Garden on the first weekend of Advent. Come and discover beautiful handmade items and meet the artisans behind these lovely creations.

title: The Sisters of Mercy
content:
Bands that once meant everything to someone can never truly die. The Sisters of Mercy, one of the great pioneers of dark rock, are such a band. With only three — albeit masterful — albums in their discography, it would be a clear exaggeration to call them prolific. Yet ever since their debut First And Last And Always in 1985, the band has remained relevant. Not least to the dark-hearted souls who once found solace in their danceable, industrial-tinged rock.

The Sisters of Mercy are returning to Sweden for three shows this autumn — November 13 at Trädgår’n in Gothenburg!
excerpt: The Sisters of Mercy are coming to Trädgår’n, Gothenburg this November!

title: The Herbarium’s Hidden Treasures
content:
A herbarium is far more than a collection of old dried plants, algae and fungi. Each pressed specimen is a preserved moment in the history of nature – gathered by botanists, explorers and researchers over the centuries. Herbaria also play an active role in modern research, linking past discoveries with today’s science.

The exhibition is a collaboration with the Gothenburg Global Biodiversity Centre and the Sambio project.

Opens at 12:00 every day and closes when the Visitor Centre closes.
Visitor Centre opening hours.

Location: Galleri Floras rike.
excerpt: “Herbariets gömda skatter” takes you on a journey through botanical exploration, contemporary research and fascinating discoveries.

title: Trees in time and motion – Dance performance
content:
Surrounded by the forest, you are invited into the world of trees, where dance, soundscapes and storytelling intertwine with current research on the lives, movements and interactions of trees.

Two dancers and an actor guide you into the forest’s own sense of time. You will have the chance to feel the texture of bark, follow the rhythm of the treetops and experience how fact and poetry meet in a sensory expression.

After the performance, you are welcome to stay and explore trees, movement and presence in nature on your own. The performance is based on five years of choreographic research into trees.

Location: Meet at the Roten venue at 17:45.
The group will then be guided to the performance site in the forest above the Skandinavium section of the Rock garden. It is important to arrive on time, as it may be difficult to find the performance otherwise.
excerpt: Experience “Träd i tid och rörelse” – a performance by Embla Dans & Teater.

featuredmedia.caption: Screenshot

title: Skandinaviengalan 2027
content:
Over the course of one evening, several of the most celebrated names in Christian music will take the stage at Scandinavium. With musicians and an extensive stage production, the atmosphere of the classic gala nights that once drew audiences from across the country to Gothenburg will be brought back to life.

Skandinaviengalan 2027 is aimed both at those who experienced the concerts of the 1980s firsthand and at new generations who want to experience the music live. It will be a night defined by community, singalongs and a strong sense of presence in one of the city’s most renowned arenas.

Artists confirmed so far:

  • Glenn Kaiser Band (formerly Resurrection Band) US
  • Per-Erik Hallin with his 80s band
  • Roland Utbult & Tactus
  • Bröderna Ådahl
  • Jerusalem
  • SALT

More names will be announced.
excerpt: On February 27 2027, Scandinavium will be filled with live bands and powerful memories as Skandinaviengalan 2027 takes over the arena. The evening draws inspiration from the major Christian galas of the 1980s and brings together renowned artists.

title: La Traviata
content:
Glamour, longing and unforgettable arias. It’s no wonder that this is one of the world’s most beloved operas.

The independent, glorious Violetta lives at the heart of the festivities, where she wishes to remain for as long as she can. There she meets Alfredo and falls in love for the first time – glimpsing a future she never believed possible, and dares to strive for it. But the world will not allow her to forget her past. Alfredo’s father coerces Violetta to renounce her love to save the family’s reputation. By the time Alfredo learns the truth, it is already too late.

Violetta is at once fragile and uncompromising in a society where men claim the right to dictate women’s choices. Verdi’s music captures her inner world with clarity: the freedom that beckons, the longing that propels her forward, and ultimately her inescapable loneliness.

Contemporary touches meet historical elegance in this new production of one of the most loved operas in the repertoire. The costumes have influences from the Baroque, the Italian mafia and carnival. La traviata has been selected for the prestigious Savonlinna Opera Festival in Finland, where it will premiere in summer 2026 performed by the Göteborg Opera’s soloists, chorus and orchestra, before opening the season here in Gothenburg.
excerpt: Happiness is always just out of reach in Verdi’s immortal classic. Libretto by Francesco Maria Piave, based on the play ‘La Dame aux Camélias’ by Alexandre Dumas fils.

featuredmedia.alt_text: Ida Falk Winland as Violetta, with several white rabbits around her.

title: Marital Secrets
content:
In Marital Secrets, you meet two rarely-performed operas. Together, they explore the habit of keeping things from the one you love – and the absurd consequences when the truth come to light.

In the tragicomic On the Harmfulness of Tobacco (originally a monologue by Anton Chekhov), a lecturer strays from his assigned topic. Instead of recounting the dangers of tobacco, he begins to speak ever more candidly about his marriage. As a frustrated husband, he lets slip the small compromises we all make to preserve a private corner of independence.

In the comedy Il segreto di Susanna (Susanna’s Secret), the same husband senses the unfamiliar smell of tobacco at home. Does his wife have a smoking lover? The couple is drawn into a playful marital dance, where they are taken from isolation to togetherness via an entertaining round of suspicion, revelation and reconciliation.

On tour in the region and on the Small Stage.
excerpt: An entertaining double-bill about matrimonial love – and the jealousies and truths that can be hidden behind smoke and mirrors.

featuredmedia.alt_text: Mattias Ermedahl and Carolina Sandgren surrounded by smoke.

title: See You Sunday & The Promise
content:
See You Sunday

Sarah Baltzinger & Isaiah Wilson

New worlds open up in Sarah Baltzinger’s and Isaiah Wilson’s See You Sunday: skewed, humorous and intensely physical. The theme is doppelgangers, and the uncanny sensations associated with them. You are drawn into a surreal realm where humour and anxiety coexist, as characters are cloned, made in inferior copies, or become rivals. The world premiere will be performed by GöteborgsOperans Danskompani in Ludwigshafen, Germany, in October.

The Promise

Felix Landerer

In The Promise, Felix Landerer explores the tensions and contradictions between the real moments that slip past as we yearn for something elsewhere, and those we try to hold onto while knowing deep-down that life is constantly changing. The piece probes the restless absorption involved in the pursuit of unrealised potential, while knowing that tomorrow is promised to no one. At its core is the hope for a deep sense of belonging.
excerpt: At last, the dance company returns to Gothenburg! After the European tour that concludes with the world premiere of See You Sunday – one of the evening’s two works – The Göteborg Opera now brings it home. See it here – and cross your heart you won’t miss The Promise.

featuredmedia.alt_text: Sabine Groenendijk and Danielle de Vries dancing on stage.

title: From Myth to Nordic Light
content:
Mozart wrote only one true flute concerto, yet it became the most celebrated of them all, its music shimmering with light and animated by inventive grace. Sibelius’s First Symphony, composed in the same year as Finlandia, marked his international breakthrough. From the solitary clarinet at the opening to the storm-driven finale, northern forests and lakes emerge in broad, expansive melodic arcs.

The concert opens with the overture to Gluck’s mythological opera Iphigénie en Tauride. It begins in a calm, idyllic spirit before breaking into turbulence, as Iphigenia and her priestesses pray for deliverance.

In autumn 2026, the Göteborg Opera Orchestra has been invited to appear at the Grosses Festspielhaus in Salzburg with excerpts from From Myth to Nordic Light.

Christoph Willibald Gluck (1756–1714): Overture to Iphigénie en Tauride. Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart (1756–1791): Flute Concerto No. 1 in G major, K. 313. Jean Sibelius (1865–1957): Symphony No. 1 in E minor, Op. 39.
excerpt: Mozart’s elegance and Sibelius’s power ignite a spark in the darkness. An autumn concert filled with melancholy and imagination.

featuredmedia.alt_text: Sabine Daniels from the Göteborg Opera Orchestra playing the flute.

title: Daft Funk Live
content:
A retrospective celebration of Daft Punk – Performed live

Respecting the original sound and aesthetics, Daft Funk delivers a pulsating concert experience packed with iconic hits, club classics, and futuristic vibes. The show blends electronic grooves, disco-infused rhythms, and a visual production that takes the audience straight to the dance floor.

This is more than a tribute — it’s a retrospective celebration of one of electronic music’s most influential acts of all time. From the early house years to global arena hits, the performance creates a complete experience where nostalgia meets contemporary energy.

A night for everyone who loves electronic music, club culture, and timeless dance hits.
excerpt: For the very first time, Daft Funk is coming to Sweden with their acclaimed live show — a spectacular, high-energy tribute to the music of Daft Punk.

featuredmedia.alt_text: Daft Funk in motorcycle gear

title: Bare State
content:
New creation

Imre & Marne van Opstal

After their individual careers as dancers, the siblings Imre and Marne van Opstal have become increasingly recognised as a choreographic duo with a powerful physical language. Their creation for Bare State will be the third piece they will have made for GöteborgsOperans Danskompani, following To Kingdom Come (2022) and Atlas Song (2024) with musician Anna von Hausswolff.

Their international profile has since grown rapidly – they recently created an acclaimed piece for the Paris Opera Ballet and choreography for the House of Dior.

New creation

Bobbi Jene Smith & Or Schraiber

When choreographers Bobbi Jene Smith and Or Schraiber created I Cannot Love Without Trembling for the dance company a few years ago, the response was emphatic, described as “extraordinarily beautiful and moving” (Svenska Dagbladet) and “brilliant” (Dagens Nyheter). The music for that piece was performed live by the Göteborg Opera Orchestra. Musicians will also contribute to this new piece. Bobbi Jene reached a wider audience through the award-winning documentary Bobbi Jene (2017) and together with Or, she has created works for institutions including the Paris Opera and the Royal Danish Ballet in Copenhagen.
excerpt: Welcome to a star-studded, memorable evening of dance. The spring’s first double-bill presents two world premieres by choreographers who have previously made a strong impact in Gothenburg.

featuredmedia.alt_text: bare state standing close together

category_heading: Bold dance that will move you

title: Luisa Miller
content:
Luisa Miller has fallen in love with Rodolfo, a man from the upper classes. Luisa’s father defends his daughter’s right to decide whom she wants to spend her life with, but power is all that matters to Rodolfo’s father, so he resists their romance. Luisa is soon caught in a web of lies, jealousy and ambition – where her freedom hangs on a choice between truth or submission. Is their love strong enough to resist wealth and power?

The setting for this new Verdi production is aboard a private yacht. Luisa and her father are part of the crew, where the boundary between the staff below decks and the opulence of the glittering salons above is as clearly defined as the difference between control and freedom. Like Schiller’s original play “Kabale und Liebe”, this new staging of Luisa Miller emerges as a compelling critique of class society, seen through an intensely human and personal lens.

Verdi composed Luisa Miller between Macbeth and Rigoletto, and this opera is every bit as powerful. The passionate music is suffused with dark undertones – tender love and white-hot fury are masterfully interwoven as the music drives the drama inexorably towards its tragic conclusion.

Opera in three acts by Giuseppe Verdi (1813–1901). Libretto by Salvatore Cammarano, based on Friedrich von Schiller’s play Kabale und Liebe.
excerpt: Verdi’s enthralling opera is an epic tragedy where love and power collide, and the music electrifies every moment.

featuredmedia.alt_text: Luisa Miller and Rodolfo dancing

title: Il barbiere di Siviglia
content:
”Musical comedy on a level one seldom encounters” Expressen
”An eclectic production which makes references to both the macarena and Abba.” Göteborgs-Posten

Figaro the barber can solve just about anything. When Rosina and Count Almaviva fall in love, Figaro immediately steps in as their self-appointed matchmaker – even though Rosina has been locked away by the old doctor Bartolo. Chaos of course ensues, as everything becomes hopelessly tangled.

Il barbiere di Siviglia is Rossini at his exuberant best. Egotism and empathy, greed and generosity – it dissects human quirks and twists them into comedy. Created in 2021, the minimal yet vibrant set places the spotlight firmly on the characters and on Rossini’s dazzling music, with its breathtaking coloratura, elegant ensemble pieces and infectious joy.

Opera in two acts by Gioachino Rossini (1792–1868). Libretto Cesare Sterbini, based on a comedy by Pierre-Augustin Caron de Beaumarchais.
excerpt: Rossini’s homage to joie de vivre and young love. What is it about love that makes everyone lose their common sense? Maybe the answer lies in Rossini’s effervescent comedy – an energetic romp that will also appeal to younger audiences.

featuredmedia.alt_text: The barber shaving a client

title: Spring Night in Vienna
content:
Mozart’s Eine kleine Nachtmusik is a much-loved delight, its playful clarity concealing a near-superhuman perfection. The performance is led by Benjamin Schmid, one of the most distinguished and versatile violinists of our time.

We will then enjoy a selection of Franz Schubert’s best-known songs, arranged for chamber orchestra by Max Reger. Schubert was a master of setting words to music, transforming poetry into sound rich in atmosphere and emotional nuance.

The evening concludes with Korngold’s Violin Concerto. Do you hear echoes of Hollywood soundtracks? Little wonder: it was largely Korngold, along with other émigrés from Europe’s opera houses and concert halls who shaped American film music in the 1930’s and 40’s. Benjamin Schmid returns as soloist to our stage; with the violin as the music’s guiding voice, he allows Korngold’s score to bloom in full colour.

Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart (1756–1791): Eine kleine Nachtmusik, K. 525. Franz Schubert (1797–1828). (Orchestration by Max Reger). Songs: An die Musik. Gesänge des Harfners: Wer sich der Einsamkeit ergibt, Wer nie sein Brot mit Tränen aß, An die Türen will ich schleichen. Erlkönig. Erich Wolfgang Korngold (1897–1957): Violin Concerto in D major, Op. 35.
excerpt: From Mozart’s serenade to Korngold’s cinematic violin concerto. This spring orchestral concert brings together three centuries of music shaped by Vienna.

featuredmedia.alt_text: Two persons playing violin

title: Manon
content:
Manon wants to live a life of love, freedom and luxury. She has a magnetic allure and embraces the effect she has on men. We follow her from the day she is sent to a convent as a young girl all the way to her final moments. In between unfolds a story involving desire, love, decadence, double-standards – and the choice between freedom or security. Manon refuses the choice, until life decides for her.

Manon is a French opera by Jules Massenet, written in the same late-Romantic style as his later work Thaïs. The elegant, nuanced music features grand choral scenes – capturing Manon’s complexity and humanity. Her joie de vivre, desire, tenderness and doubt have enthralled audiences for generations. This production is directed by Eirik Stubø, who has been acclaimed for his ability to craft convincing characters with psychological depth.

Opera in five acts by Jules Massenet (1842–1912). Libretto by Henri Meilhac and Philippe Gille, based on the Abbé Prévost’s novel Manon Lescaut.
excerpt: An enduring French classic about the irresistible Manon – a woman bold enough to choose everything. With sensuous music and intense emotion, we follow her encounters with romance, freedom and the dream of a larger than life.

featuredmedia.alt_text: Manon in blond hair wearing a black top

title: Big in Japan
content:
In recent decades, Japanese popular culture has grown to become an integral part of our lives. Video games, television series and the films of Studio Ghibli are loved by children, teenagers and adults alike – and not least for their music. Big in Japan brings this repertoire to be performed by the Göteborg Opera’s Orchestra and Chorus.

Rickard Söderberg will guide you through the worlds of Spirited Away, My Neighbour Totoro, The Legend of Zelda, Final Fantasy and more! This concert is for everyone who loves what is truly Big in Japan.

A production by The Concert Factory AB. Illustration: Natalia Batista
excerpt: From Totoro to Zelda. Drift away to Japan through your favourite music from movies, games and anime. Rickard Söderberg presents.

featuredmedia.caption: Illustration: Natalia Batista.
featuredmedia.alt_text: Illustration, different game characters playing different instruments

category_heading: Concert with anime and video game music.

title: In Bed with Santa
content:
Since premiering in Stockholm in 2024, In Bed with Santa has become a major audience hit. Now, the much loved production comes to Gothenburg for three final performances this December.

Based on the beloved 1999 film, the show offers a fast paced and sharply observed take on a Christmas dinner that quickly spirals out of control. What begins as a festive gathering for a modern blended family soon turns into an evening full of revelations, old tensions and hilariously awkward twists.

Returning to the stage is the hit ensemble, featuring some of Sweden’s most beloved actors: Liv Mjönes, Linus Wahlgren, Eva Röse, Jakob Setterberg, Fredrik Hallgren, Clara Henry, Magnus Betnér, Julia Dufvenius, Inez Dahl Torhaug, Anton Lundqvist and Eva Rexed.

The result is an entertaining mix of relatable moments, Christmas stress and high energy comedy. Whether you want to lean into the festive spirit or simply laugh at someone else’s family chaos for an evening, this is a perfect addition to your December calendar.
excerpt: Christmas 2026 brings an extra dose of laughter and family chaos to Gothenburg as In Bed with Santa comes to Scandinavium. The acclaimed stage adaptation of the Swedish cult classic wraps up its tour in Gothenburg on December 18–20.

title: Sparkling Gothenburg
content:
At Sparkling Göteborg, you’ll experience the very best of the world’s sparkling wines along with perfectly matched delicacies. Here you’ll find some of the most knowledgeable suppliers of sparkling wine, where you can learn more and taste both new discoveries and classic favourites from the world of sparkling wine.

Visitor information

Sparkling Göteborg is divided into four different sessions, and the fair releases a limited number of tickets for each one. As a visitor, you attend the event during your selected time slot before making room for new guests. To have enough time to explore, taste, and learn more about the products, it’s recommend to arrive early.

Session 1: Friday 13:00–16:30
Session 2: Friday 17:30–21:00

Session 3: Saturday 11:00–15:00
Session 4: Saturday 16:00–20:00

There is no bag ban during Sparkling Göteborg, but you may be asked to show the contents of your bag at the entrance. You also have the option to check your bag in the cloakroom if needed.
excerpt: Gothenburg’s popular sparkling wine fair is back on October 16–17. A sparkling event featuring champagne, cava, crémant, and other sparkling wines at Clarion Hotel Post in Gothenburg.

featuredmedia.alt_text: Two people toasting with sparkling wine.

title: Miss Li
content:
On 14 November, Miss Li stops in Gothenburg as part of the celebration of her 20 years as an artist. After a summer marked by record interest and several sold out shows, the tour now continues to Scandinavium.

With a long list of hits and a well established place in the Swedish music scene, Miss Li has built a strong connection with audiences over the years. Her concert at Scandinavium is the perfect night out for anyone looking to experience Swedish pop live in Gothenburg this autumn.
excerpt: This autumn, Miss Li comes to Gothenburg with her anniversary tour NU SOM DÅ FÖR EVIGT. A major concert night awaits at Scandinavium with one of Sweden’s most beloved artists.

featuredmedia.alt_text: Miss Li against a pink wall.

title: Myles Sanko (UK) 2026
content:
When Myles Sanko last played Nefertiti, it sold out. Now the charismatic British soul and jazz artist returns to Gothenburg for another night of warmth, groove, and heartfelt storytelling.

Born in Accra, Ghana and raised in Cambridge, Sanko’s music reflects a rich cultural heritage, blending soul, jazz, and modern groove. His powerful voice and honest lyrics explore themes of love, hope, and contemporary life.

Following a string of acclaimed releases and collaborations with artists like Gregory Porter, Sanko has become one of Europe’s most respected voices in modern soul and jazz. He is currently touring his latest album Let It Unfold, showcasing his signature mix of warm soul, refined jazz arrangements, and strong storytelling.

Don’t miss his return to Nefertiti. Last time sold out – and this night will be no different.
excerpt: Live, Myles Sanko creates something truly special – a concert as much about feeling and connection as it is about music.

featuredmedia.alt_text: picture of myles sanko

title: Okvsho (CH)
content:
Okvsho is the Zurich-based project of brothers Georg and Christoph Kiss – a quietly rising phenomenon with a growing global audience and a strong following among record collectors.

From Orange Wine to A Place Between Us, the duo has built an international listenership and a unique sonic identity. Following a 2025 European tour, including a sold-out show at Jazz Cafe, they return with their upcoming album FROZEN FLASHES, released September 18, 2026.

Live, Okvsho and the six-piece band Experience where improvisation, trust, and the idea of jazz as dance music take center stage – creating a dynamic, ever-evolving performance where no two shows are the same.
excerpt: Blending beatmaking, electronic music, and modern jazz, they’ve quickly become one of Switzerland’s most distinctive acts.

featuredmedia.alt_text: poster with album text frozen flashes

title: Jembaa Groove (DE)
content:
Jembaa Groove opens their 2026 tour with new material and an updated lineup, blending Highlife, jazz, and afrobeats into a warm, deeply rhythmic sound. With roots in Berlin and strong ties to Lagos’ afro-fusion scene, the band continues to push the boundaries of modern jazz.

Following sold-out shows across Europe, a debut US tour, and acclaimed performances at festivals like Lowlands Festivaland XJAZZ Festival, they now enter a new phase – joined by renowned multi-instrumentalist Kwame Yeboah.

Forward-moving yet deeply rooted, this is music that connects on a human level.
excerpt: One of Europe’s most talked-about Afro-jazz acts right now live at Nefertiti.

featuredmedia.alt_text: jemba groove music band

title: West of Eden – Celtic Christmas
content:
Last year, West of Eden embarked on yet another sold‑out Christmas tour and received glowing reviews both in Sweden and internationally. Now they return to 23 cities across Sweden, inviting audiences to enjoy traditional Christmas tunes, lively folk songs, medieval hymns and modern favourites such as

Fairytale of New York – all brought together in a magical and atmospheric Christmas concert.
“The best of contemporary folk” – Irish Music Magazine

Today, West of Eden is unquestionably one of Sweden’s leading folk‑rock bands. Over the years, they have built a loyal following both at home and abroad, thanks to high‑quality songwriting and a distinctive folk‑inspired sound of their own. Vocalist Jenny Schaub’s expressive and unmistakable voice adds the perfect finishing touch.

“A masterpiece of Christmas music that could be enjoyed at any time” – Nicky Rossiter, Rambles

West of Eden have released twelve albums to date. Their live recordings from the Celtic Christmas concerts, as well as the album Next Stop Christmas (2022), have been widely praised by Swedish and international media. Reviews such as “A masterpiece of Christmas music” and “Guaranteed goosebumps” say it all.
excerpt: During their Celtic Christmas celebration Celtic Christmas, Irish and English folk music takes centre stage.

featuredmedia.alt_text: West of Eden seated together beside a Christmas tree

title: The Grissini Project – The Best Music from Studio Ghibli
content: On the set list are iconic themes from Princess Mononoke, My Neighbor Totoro, Castle in the Sky, Howl’s Moving Castle, Porco Rosso, Spirited Away and many more. Blending classical finesse with pop-culture flair, this concert takes you to Studio Ghibli’s enchanted Japan through the unforgettable melodies of Joe Hisaishi.
excerpt: A quartet of pop-culture-loving musicians, the Grissini Project will perform the loveliest pieces from Hayao Miyazaki’s animated masterpieces.

featuredmedia.alt_text: Illustration of a colourful landscape

title: Coffee Music
content:
Concert length: 1 hour including intermission.

Stage: Götaplatsfoajén.
excerpt: Coffee, sandwich and sweet chamber music with musicians and singers from the Gothenburg Symphony, a collaboration with the Friends of the Gothenburg Symphony.

featuredmedia.alt_text: violins and strings

title: Baby Rhythmics
content:
Experience the music up close in the Gothenburg Concert Hall foyer. In a small group, you and your baby get to sing and move to well-known melodies and rhymes alternated with new acquaintances from classical music. The groups are led by Angelina Mangs, percussionist and producer. No prior knowledge is needed.

The ticket price also includes coffee after the rhythm session, where you have the opportunity to meet other parents and babies.

Entrance from Götaplatsen at Stenhammarsgatan 1, door 3. There is space for strollers.
excerpt: A playful, creative activity for you and your baby. Well-known melodies and rhymes are alternated with new acquaintances from classical music. Ages: 6–18 months.

featuredmedia.alt_text: Babies in full action

title: The Gothenburg Sound
content:
From underground to a world-class symphonic sound. The Gothenburg Symphony Orchestra takes on the melodious death metal that has put Gothenburg on the rock map forever. Riffs become fiery string passages and thrilling percussion in iconic songs from At The Gates, Dark Tranquillity and In Flames. No amplified guitars, no growling vocals – but even more power in the full winds, strings and percussion opening gates to surprising new dimensions.

Led by conductor Josef Rhedin, we get to experience key works from the three bands in specially written arrangements by Johan Lindström and composer John Metcalfe. Metcalfe is known for his work with artists including U2, Coldplay and Peter Gabriel.

Even those who have never set foot in a hard rock concert will find something to connect to in this melodic world. Much of the Gothenburg sound is adjacent to Swedish folk and traditional classical music – with a clear sense of sorrow, long melodies and a varied style combining raw and sweet elements.

“Hearing our music, together with songs from Dark Tranquillity and In Flames, translated for full orchestra is something we never could have imagined when this all began.” – At the Gates

This concert is also a warm tribute in memory of Tomas “Tompa” Lindberg. As frontman of At The Gates, Lindberg was one of the most important individuals behind the Gothenburg sound.

Conductor Josef Rhedin moves comfortably between musicals, opera and symphonic music and has worked with the Royal Stockholm Philharmonic Orchestra, Gothenburg Symphony Orchestra and the Malmö Symphony Orchestra, as well as Robyn and Helen Sjöholm.

This is the concert for anyone who is curious about Gothenburg’s modern music legacy. Two of the city’s most important musical exports meet here: hard rock and the Gothenburg Symphony, opening the doors to anyone who wants to step inside.
excerpt: From underground to world-class orchestral sound. The Gothenburg Symphony Orchestra takes on the death metal that has put Gothenburg on the rock map forever. Hear iconic songs from At The Gates, Dark Tranquillity and In Flames in a symphonic take.

featuredmedia.alt_text: Illustration, Gothenburg Sound

title: Bo Kaspers Orkester
content: When Bo Kaspers Orkester steps onto the stage again, it’s not just another concert. It’s a summary of an entire life’s work. From the first tentative notes in a small restaurant on Kungsholmen to sold‑out venues across the north, Bo Kaspers Orkester has become a natural companion through both everyday moments and celebrations. Il magnifico is an audiovisual concert experience where the band’s rich catalogue meets a newly crafted visual universe.
excerpt: Bo Kaspers Orkester celebrates 35 years with the grand anniversary show Il magnifico. On December 4, the show arrives at Scandinavium in Gothenburg.

featuredmedia.alt_text: Poster for Bo Kaspers Orkester

title: The World of Hans Zimmer – A New Dimension
content:
In this acclaimed production, Hans Zimmer serves as the musical director and curator behind the concept, even though he does not appear on stage himself. Instead, the music is performed by a large live ensemble led by the multi–Grammy-nominated conductor Matt Dunkley, together with world-class musicians, soloists, and choir. Newly arranged orchestral suites meet powerful stage design, visual projections, and a soundscape that transforms the concert into a cinematic experience of its own.

Since the premiere of its predecessor, The World of Hans Zimmer – A Symphonic Celebration in 2018, the concert series has grown into a global phenomenon, attracting more than two million visitors worldwide.
excerpt: On April 23, 2027, it’s time for the spectacular orchestral experience The World of Hans Zimmer – A New Dimension. The audience will be taken on a grand journey through some of the most iconic musical pieces in film history.

featuredmedia.alt_text: Poster for Hans Zimmer's concert

title: Anthems – Christmas show at Trädgår’n
content:
Anthems is a spectacular holiday production where tradition meets timeless musical moments. We bring the greatest and most legendary concert experiences from the world’s most iconic arenas to the stage at Trädgår’n, right in the heart of Gothenburg. From powerful rock classics to modern crowd favorites – songs everyone knows, performed by artists everyone recognizes. Experience the magic of Queen at Live Aid, feel the pulse of Taylor Swift at Madison Square Garden, and relive the energy when Bruce Springsteen takes over Ullevi. These moments – and everything in between – come to life on stage. These are the songs you remember, the moments you’ll never forget, and the feeling of being right in the middle of the crowd when it all happens.

On stage, a star-studded ensemble of well-known artists, seasoned veterans, and exciting newcomers – all with the power to deliver these immortal anthems with both heart and precision. The full cast will be revealed in a press release on April 20.

The evening begins with a classic Christmas buffet, but after that, the experience takes a completely different turn. We leave sleigh bells and carols behind and step straight into the biggest, boldest, and most iconic live moments in music history.

Anthems is not your typical Christmas show. It’s a tribute to the greatest live music moments of all time – a night filled with energy, nostalgia, and pure musical euphoria.

It’s big. It’s grand. It’s Anthems.
excerpt: HELD Management, A STAR Entertainment and Trädgår’n proudly present ANTHEMS – a Christmas show like no other.

featuredmedia.alt_text: Poster for Anthems

title: Autumn Break Choir: Matters of the Heart
content:
Leader is Tobias Ljungman from Kentkören Gothenburg together with his brother, guitarist Simon Ljungman.

The hit parade that the band Kent produced during more than 30 years on stage never ceases to captivate. There is love, passion, humor and intensity. Similar emotional lyrics and biting melodies were written by the British lute player John Dowland 400 years ago; he was the most popular singer-songwriter of the Renaissance. In the autumn holiday 2026, these two worlds will unite in Gothenburg’s best youth choir.

Join us to develop your singing voice and stage presence at one of the world’s most beautiful concert halls. You are in the ages 14–23 and can read music. The grand finale is this concert in the spectacular Great Hall!

Want to join?
Find more information about the Autumn Break Choir and how to join.
excerpt: Join us as the Autumn Holiday Choir forms its own Kent choir! Love and matters of the heart are in focus when the Autumn Holiday Choir sings music from John Dowland to Jocke Berg. The final concert is a festive experience in the Great hall.

title: Christmas in Ireland
content:
The audience favourite returns! Following previous successes such as Fairytale for Christmas, the popular Irish Christmas show is back in Sweden – this time under the name Christmas in Ireland. It’s the same warm blend of music, storytelling and Irish festive spirit that has made the tour a recurring favourite, now presented in a fresh new format.

Christmas in Ireland transports audiences to a traditional Irish pub on Christmas Eve, where friends and strangers gather to share songs, stories and memories. With lively interpretations of Irish classics, powerful ballads and well-known Christmas songs, the show recreates the atmosphere that has made this tour so beloved: warm, entertaining and full of musical energy. From the producers of Seven Drunken Nights and performed by a strong ensemble of singers and musicians, the show features favourites such as Driving Home for Christmas, Dirty Old Town and Fairytale of New York.
excerpt: Irish pub warmth in the heart of the winter darkness.

featuredmedia.alt_text: Poster for Christmas in Irland

title: Amanda Ginsburg – It’s Christmas Again
content:
Joining Amanda on stage are musicians of the very highest Scandinavian calibre: her long‑time collaborator and co‑composer Filip Ekestubbe (piano), Snorre Kirk (drums) and Niklas Fernqvist (double bass). Expect an evening filled with Amanda’s signature everyday observations and swing, wrapped in sparkling Christmas decorations and a hint of saffron bun from the underground kiosk.

“I don’t see myself as particularly tradition‑bound, but when it comes to Christmas music I’ve realised that I rarely renew myself,” Amanda says. “We need Christmas music that reflects the times and traditions we live in today – music that awakens more than just our nostalgic side.”

With two Grammy Awards and a unique ability to put everyday experiences into words that resonate with many, Amanda has become one of Sweden’s most beloved jazz voices. Rooted in the Swedish singer‑songwriter and jazz traditions, she creates music that feels both new and familiar at the same time.
excerpt: As the November darkness gives way to Advent stars glowing in the windows, Amanda Ginsburg sets off on her very first Christmas tour. With newly written Christmas songs that find their place between mulled wine and Christmas ham, cherished traditions are accompanied by fresh new sounds.

featuredmedia.alt_text: Amanda Ginsburg

title: Master Boot Record, Fulci & Arottenbit
content:
Behind Master Boot Record is Italian producer Victor Love (Vittorio D’Amore), who since 2016 has built a unique project where heavy metal meets synth‑driven electronics inspired by computer culture and retro‑futuristic themes. With albums such as Floppy Disk Overdrive, Personal Computer and Hardwarez, the project has become one of the most talked‑about names in the growing cyber‑metal scene.

Fulci represent a completely different – yet equally uncompromising – side of the modern metal spectrum. The Italian death metal band takes its name from cult filmmaker Lucio Fulci and builds its aesthetic around classic splatter cinema. With brutal riffs, cinematic atmospheres and a clear love for the horror genre, Fulci have created a universe of their own, where each album feels like the soundtrack to a blood‑soaked cult film.
excerpt: Two of the most distinctive acts in extreme music join forces this autumn as Master Boot Record and Fulci embark on a co‑headline tour with Arottenbit as support.

featuredmedia.alt_text: Poster for Master Boot record

title: In The Spotlight: From Di Leva To Bowie
content:
The evening begins in a relaxed and welcoming atmosphere, where you take your seat in the stalls with a great view of the stage. Conversations flow, anticipation builds, and the room fills with that special feeling that only comes when something magical is about to happen.

We then turn the spotlight to one of Sweden’s most unique artists—Thomas Di Leva. With his acclaimed show From Di Leva to Bowie, he takes you on a journey through time and space. From his own beloved classics to interpretations of David Bowie’s iconic catalog, a deeply moving concert experience unfolds.

The “cosmic flower” from Gävle has released 22 albums, featuring hits like “Who Should I Trust?” and “We Only Have Each Other.” He puts words to emotions we all feel but may struggle to express. Recently, he has toured the country with his critically acclaimed David Bowie tribute “Changes”—a fascinating concert through time and space where audiences can enjoy Bowie’s greatest hits, interpreted and arranged by Di Leva himself.

It’s intimate, it’s warm, it’s heartfelt—and at times, truly grand. Just like life itself.

In the Spotlight is more than a show. It’s an evening to settle into, share, and carry with you long after it ends.

For wheelchair accessibility information, please contact boka@tradgarn.se.
excerpt: An evening where music, emotion, and presence take center stage. In the new concept In the Spotlight, the line between stage and audience fades—here, you’re not just a spectator, you’re part of the experience.

title: Amused By Tech
content:
Welcome to one of the most anticipated hi-fi fair of the year. An experience for all your senses.
Step into a world where sound quality is at the centre and the passion for music unites enthusiasts, collectors and curious visitors. Here, the latest in consumer electronics meets timeless classics in an inspiring mix of innovation and nostalgia.

Discover an impressive record market filled with vinyl, CDs and rarities – perfect for those who want to find new favourites or complete their collection. Try out top-of-the-line headphones and experience sound in a whole new way, whether you’re an audiophile or just love really good music.

Whether you are a die-hard enthusiast or just curious about better sound, this is the show you should visit.

Welcome to listen, discover and be inspired!
excerpt: Where technology disappears and the music takes place

featuredmedia.alt_text: a woman listening to music via headphones. VBesides ther are two large speakers

title: VÄGUS: Mahler Symphony No. 1
content:
The spectacular first symphony by Gustav Mahler is called Titan. But it is not only full of grandeur. It also contains simple melodies and sorrowful sounds. Among other things, he picked up themes from Jewish folk songs. The finale is the despair of a broken heart.It is a challenge for any orchestra to journey into Mahler’s rich world, but as always, VÄGUS takes on this classic with courage and passion. Attend yourself and experience the sound.

As musicians move on to other assignments, new people have the chance to become familiar with the VÄGUS life, with rehearsals, camp weekends and tours of the region. Auditions are held each year. You are 14-23 years of age and have made solid progress in your musical development. Before your audition, it’s recommended attending one of the concerts.
excerpt: Gustav Mahler’s Symphony No. 1 is solemn and melancholy, with folk tones and a stormy conclusion. The Västra Götaland Youth Orchestra take on a masterpiece. Conductor Andreas Hanson.

featuredmedia.alt_text: A stage in red light

title: Family Concert: In Search of Sunshine
content:
With the help of a string quartet and the music of Beethoven, we will go in search of the missing light. And perhaps together, we will begin to look forward to the next day.

Script by Vic Vem and Mats Kjelbye.
excerpt: A mystery about everyday joys – the light that takes you from one day to the next. With the help of a string quartet from the Gothenburg Symphony Orchestra and Beethoven, we will go in search of the light that has disappeared. From age 6.

featuredmedia.alt_text: A shining sun, in front of it stands a girl with a red cap

title: Family Christmas celebration
content:
Hear new and old Christmas carols, and don’t be surprised if we all get to join in to sing some songs together. The Gothenburg Symphony brass ensemble, choirs and soloists present dazzling music for a winter evening.

Tomas von Brömssen is the host.
excerpt: Christmas begins at Gothenburg Concert Hall. Hear new and old Christmas tunes as the Gothenburg Symphony brass ensemble, choirs and soloists present dazzling music for a winter evening.

title: Polstjärnepriset Award 2027
content:
Prepare for an exciting afternoon at Gothenburg Concert Hall as four finalists compete for Polstjärnepriset Nordic Edition. The competing soloists who perform with the Gothenburg Symphony Orchestra are 14–18 years of age.

About Polstjärnepriset

With the motto “More than a competition,” Polstjärnepriset is a unique initiative and a national meeting place for talented young classical musicians. It is a forum at which young musicians can meet like-minded individuals, put their technical and stage skills to the test in the various parts of the competition – and above all, have the opportunity to learn from a renowned group of instructors. In parallel with the competition, a class is held that is open to musicians up to age 20. A total of approximately 60 young people participate in Polstjärnepriset each year.

Through individual teaching, masterclasses, and playing in chamber and orchestral ensembles, participants in the class and competition have the opportunity to grow as musicians, both individually and in groups. First everyone meets for four days over the autumn holiday to get to know one another, learn, and rehearse together. The next meeting is the first week in January, when the focus is on the competition, which has three phases, and preparations for the concerts. The highlight is the final concert at Gothenburg Concert Hall.

Polstjärnepriset is arranged by Nationellt centrum för musiktalanger.
excerpt: An exciting afternoon at Gothenburg Concert Hall as four finalists compete for first place in the Polstjärnepriset Nordic Edition. The competing soloists who perform with the Gothenburg Symphony Orchestra are 14–18 years of age.
